output.summary: A user whose endometriosis pain returned three months after laparoscopy asked whether they needed another surgery and felt defeated. The bot explained the role of hormonal management, discussed options given their past pill intolerance such as a hormonal IUD, covered when repeat surgery is considered, and gave a three-step plan. The user said they felt clearer and less like it was surgery forever.
